v.t: When the hypocrites come to you, they say, “We bear witness that you are God’s Messenger.” God knows that you are His Messenger, and God bears witness that the hypocrites are liars
v.l: Idha Ja'aka Al-Munafiquna Qalu Nash/hadu 'Innaka Larasulu Allahi Wa Allahu Ya`lamu 'Innaka Larasuluhu Wa Allahu Yash/hadu 'Inna Al-Munafiqina Lakadhibuna

v.t: They treat their oaths as a cover, and so they repel others from God’s path. Evil is what they do
v.l: Attakhadhu 'Aymanahum Junnatan Fasaddu `An Sabili Allahi 'Innahum Sa'a Ma Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: That is because they believed, and then disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed, and they cannot understand
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahum 'Amanu Thumma Kafaru Fatubi`a `Ala Qulubihim Fahum La Yafqahuna

v.t: When you see them, their appearance impresses you. And when they speak, you listen to what they say. They are like propped-up timber. They think every shout is aimed at them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. God condemns them; how deluded they are
v.l: Wa 'Idha Ra'aytahum Tu`jibuka 'Ajsamuhum Wa 'In Yaqulu Tasma` Liqawlihim Ka'annahum Khushubun Musannadatun Yahsabuna Kulla Sayhatin `Alayhim Humu Al-`Aduwu Fahdharhum Qatalahumu Allahu 'Anna Yu'ufakuna

v.t: And when it is said to them, “Come, the Messenger of God will ask forgiveness for you,” they bend their heads, and you see them turning away arrogantly
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qila Lahum Ta`alaw Yastaghfir Lakum Rasulu Allahi Lawwaw Ru'usahum Wa Ra'aytahum Yasudduna Wa Hum Mustakbiruna

v.t: It is the same for them, whether you ask forgiveness for them, or do not ask forgiveness for them; God will not forgive them. God does not guide the sinful people
v.l: Sawa'un `Alayhim 'Astaghfarta Lahum 'Am Lam Tastaghfir Lahum Lan Yaghfira Allahu Lahum 'Inna Allaha La Yahdi Al-Qawma Al-Fasiqina

v.t: It is they who say: “Do not spend anything on those who side with God’s Messenger, unless they have dispersed.” To God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand
v.l: Humu Al-Ladhina Yaquluna La Tunfiqu `Ala Man `Inda Rasuli Allahi Hatta Yanfađđu Wa Lillahi Khaza'inu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Lakinna Al-Munafiqina La Yafqahuna

v.t: They say, “If we return to the City, the more powerful therein will evict the weak.” But power belongs to God, and His Messenger, and the believers; but the hypocrites do not know
v.l: Yaquluna La'in Raja`na 'Ila Al-Madinati Layukhrijanna Al-'A`azzu Minha Al-'Adhalla Wa Lillahi Al-`Izzatu Wa Lirasulihi Wa Lilmu'uminina Wa Lakinna Al-Munafiqina La Ya`lamuna

v.t: O you who believe! Let neither your possessions nor your children distract you from the remembrance of God. Whoever does that—these are the losers
v.l: Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhina 'Amanu La Tulhikum 'Amwalukum Wa La 'Awladukum `An Dhikri Allahi Wa Man Yaf`al Dhalika Fa'ula'ika Humu Al-Khasiruna

v.t: And give from what We have provided for you, before death approaches one of you, and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a short while, so that I may be charitable, and be one of the righteous.”
v.l: Wa 'Anfiqu Min Ma Razaqnakum Min Qabli 'An Ya'tiya 'Ahadakumu Al-Mawtu Fayaqula Rabbi Lawla 'Akhartani 'Ila 'Ajalin Qaribin Fa'assaddaqa Wa 'Akun Mina As-Salihina

v.t: But God will not delay a soul when its time has come. God is Informed of what you do
v.l: Wa Lan Yu'uakhira Allahu Nafsaan 'Idha Ja'a 'Ajaluha Wa Allahu Khabirun Bima Ta`maluna
